content: Mbǝghanbǝg Yesu kǝ daddakwa ǝmtsamtsa dǝv Palla
Gwiya dagha ba nǝ Yesu damma guda dzahava. Vaakwahiina ndza mǝng nǝ uuda nǝ iin ǝmtsaǝmtsan dǝv palla.
Ma uudahi ndzar vaakwahiina, kyalmahaatǝra ndzarandzǝg ba ɗewwa ar zhargaan mbatak da mbǝgaan kǝ uuda nǝ iin daghuvala faciya ngiiga, kiyava tlǝkǝtlǝg kǝ iitǝr dǝ haipa.
Am Yesu taa kǝ daddakwa ǝmtsaǝmtsan dǝvaana, “Assagal ghacaghacig tǝvuukw vaakwana.”
Kaa ndavtǝru ndavǝg kǝ Yesu amaa, “Haiyakiyamanthaig nǝ adzahadzaha Muus kǝ ɓa dǝgit maraw davala ngiig nii ɓagvǝna kǝladǝrhi? Ngǝdlǝvǝna shifǝgnii tsǝvanhi?” Maay wa mbǝɗghant ghaiyan biya.

Kaa vaztǝrvazǝg kǝ Yesu ba da palla pal dǝ badzǝga rǝviɗmahuda, kaa hǝrsa rǝviɗ kǝ iin mbakyarvad dǝgdǝgka ǝrviɗ mahuɗaatǝra. Aiyama taa kǝ daddakwa ǝmtsaǝmtsa dǝvna, “Vǝllǝg kǝ dǝvagha.” Kaa vǝlgaan kǝ iina, kaa mbǝgambǝg kǝ dǝvaan ba fakya.
Kaa ba dagal kǝ Farisiyaha da ɓa dabari ǝmtaɗ dǝ uudaha Hirudus kǝ ɗuuli ar da tsǝg nǝ iitǝr kǝ Yesu.
Dzahav ɗyak tǝ ghaiya dǝlva Galili
Kaa ciya dagal kǝ Yesu ar dǝ mbǝrzahaan ma kǝsiina, da tǝ ghaiya dǝlva Galili ba davaatǝra, dlaba kaa gatǝgaan kǝ uudah ba ɗyaka vaivaiya ma haaya Galili,
ma kǝsa Wurshalima, ma Idumiya, ar dǝ lii kilga zaagha Judan, ar dǝ uudaha Taya ar dǝ Sidun. Aɗaba cinngaracinng kǝ dǝgitahi ɓag nǝ iina.
Mbakyarvad ɗyakǝra uudaha, kaa tagtǝrtag nǝ Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaana, aa sarardǝvsǝg kǝ perayu kwa ngyikwaha, haik kǝ tlagaan kǝ iitǝra.
Mbakyarvad mbǝghanambǝg kǝ uudah ba ɗyaka, baɗǝm lii dǝ kuzaha ar tlagakǝva kiyava tapǝgaana.
Baɗǝm sarti ar nǝghǝga shǝɗǝkw ghwaɗaha, ar nǝghaghǝr ba kǝ mbǝɗǝg tǝvuukwana ar huulǝg ar taakiya, “Agha Zǝra Daadamazhigǝla.”
Kaa ɓǝltǝraɓǝlǝg kǝ iin kǝ magi ba vaivai kǝ shǝɗǝkw ghwaɗah taakiya, aa tagararbi kǝ uudah man war nai biya.
Dzǝrghaaka dzǝrǝg Yesu kǝ mbǝrzah kǝlawa tar buwa
Tǝhala kwaha, kaa dagat kǝ Yesu damma aghwa, ɗahant kǝ lii naag nǝ iina, kaa da vakaan kǝ iitǝra.
Kaa dzǝrgaaka dzǝrǝg kǝ iin kǝ kǝlawa tar bu ma taatakatǝra (kwa ɗaatǝr nǝ iin dǝ Zǝrɓǝlgahaana). Aɗaba kiyava ndzǝgaan kǝ iitǝr ǝmtaɗ dǝ iina dlaɓa ɓǝltǝrǝt da taa ǝlbǝg marawa.
Da vǝltǝr dlaɓ kǝ ndzǝɗa lagwa shǝɗǝkw ghwaɗaha.
Wan kǝlawatar buna dzǝrghaaka nǝ iina. Siman, (kwa fǝgharva Yesu kǝ ɗaag Bitrus)
Yakubu zǝra Zabadi ar dǝ zǝrababaan Yuhwana, (kwa fatǝrva nǝ iin kǝ ɗaag Buwarnajis, zarha karazhigǝla)
Andrawus, Filigus, Bartilumi, Matiyu, Tuma, Yakub zǝra Halfa, Tadiyus, Siman, kwa naagaan kǝ zaa vuukwa kǝssaana,
Yahuda Iskariyuti, kwa vǝlǝt Yesu.
Uudah ar taaki mǝng Baˈalzabul ma vǝgha Yesu
Tǝhala kwaha kaa daas kǝ Yesu da hǝnnyaha, kaa gwiya dzahav dlaɓ kǝ uudaha baz za kaf pǝletǝrvaapilǝg kǝ Yesu ar dǝ mbǝrzahaana.
Cinngara ba nǝ yaatǝr ndǝkwana, kaa dagau kǝ iitǝr da saa dǝ vakaiya, aɗaba yaatǝr ar taaki, “Nalnǝg kǝ valaaga.”
Am nǝ lii tsaga adzahadzaha Muusi saral ma Wurshalima, “Mǝng Baˈalzabul, Maala Shatanah ma vǝghaana. Tlakǝna vakaan kǝ ndzǝɗa lagwa shǝɗkw ghwaɗaha.”
Kaa ɗahtǝrantɗahǝg Yesu kǝ uudahiin, kaa tagtǝr kǝ ǝlbǝg dǝ garav taakiya, “Lagwalagw Shatanah kǝ zǝraabaan Shatanaha?”
Abi, ma tagwavǝmtagw nǝ kwarǝg hutsǝg buwa, kwan kǝ kwarǝga ghaciga biya.
Band kwah dlaɓa, ma tagwavǝmtagw hǝnnyah hutsǝg buwa, kwan kǝ hǝnnyaha ghacig biya.
Dlaɓa akwama cigharantciig shatanah kǝ ghǝraana tagwvǝm hutsǝg buwa, ghacig biya. Sǝghaasǝgga halavuwan.
Maay wa dzugwantdzugw kǝ daas damma vǝgya dadda ndzǝɗ hutsarva kǝ kadlangahaan biya, bamma viyit kǝ uudanǝn nguɗǝnan, Lakuti hutsǝgarvahutsǝg kǝ kadlangaha vǝgyaana.
“Ən tagkurtag kǝ jiira, da ɓǝshǝvtǝrnaɓǝshǝg aanji hulfa kwar kǝ haipahi ɓagara nǝ uudaha, ar dǝ ǝlbǝga nenegahi ɓagarara nǝ iitǝr kǝ Daadamazhigǝla.
Ai ciya, baɗǝm dadda kwa tagǝda ǝlbǝga nenǝg tǝ Shǝɗǝkw Daadamazhigǝla, da ɓǝshvarnaabi ba tangw damma zǝrazǝra biya. Ɓagaaɓag kǝ haipi kwada ɓǝshvarnaabi ba tangw damma zǝrazǝr biya.”
Tagaatag Yesu kwan mbakyarvad ar taakiya, “Dǝ shǝɗkw ghwaɗ nǝ iina.”
Babba Yesu ar dǝ zarha babbaana
Kaa sagau kǝ babba Yesu ar dǝ zarha babbaan. Ar ghacan gyimala ar ɓǝlant kǝ uud da ɗaagaana.
Ndza mǝng nǝ uudah ba ɗyaka ar cahwargan faɗagaan tǝghǝr kǝ iina, am nǝ uuda nǝ iin taa kǝ iina, “Wai baabagh ard zarha baabagh ar ghacǝga gyimala ar naa nǝgha kǝgha.”
Kaa ndavgaru ndavǝg kǝ Yesu taakiya, “War baabara, ard zarha baabarni?”
Kaa vaztǝrvazǝg kǝ iin kǝ lii cahwarga tǝvǝgh kǝ iina, aiyama, “Wan nǝ baabara ard zaraabahara.
Ba ɗǝm daddakwa ɓa dǝgiti naag Daadamazhigǝla, iin zǝraabara, iin nǝ dǝghwa baabara, iin dlaɓ baabara.”
